The '''sarcophagus''' of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dramath the Second]] was kept within [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Dramath the Second's tomb|personal tomb]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rekkiad]]. It was made of granite, with an interweaving pattern of diagonal lines and circles, probably a family crest or seal, carved into its sides. At some point, an [[Unidentified Sith emissary|emissary]] working for Dramath's enemy and half-brother [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] discovered Dramath's tomb with the help of [[Mandalore the Ultimate]], and opened the sarcophagus, taking Dramath's remains for his master.

After the defeat of the Mandalorians during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]] hid [[Mandalore's Mask]] within the sarcophagus, where they also discovered a [[Dramath the Second's datacron|datacron]] with information about Dramath and his history.
